issues.title: Clippy while_let_loop compilation error fails `make lint`
issues.resolution: Fixed by remediator r1: parse_flags loop in crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:103 replaced with `while let Some(flag) = pending.take().or_else(|| it.next())`. Verified: `make lint` exit 0 (cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings, 'Finished dev profile').
issues.why_it_matters: `make lint` runs `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`. Clippy generates an error on the new parse_flags loop in main.rs, causing make lint to fail with exit code 101. The developer claimed clippy was clean in §9 and the run log.
issues.impact: CI gate failure; repository does not pass make lint or make check.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:103:5: error: this loop could be written as a `while let` loop
issues.proposed_fix: In crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:103, replace `loop { let Some(flag) = pending.take().or_else(|| it.next()) else { break; }; ... }` with `while let Some(flag) = pending.take().or_else(|| it.next()) { ... }`.

issues.title: Racy port allocation in `explicit_address_is_honored` causes intermittent test failure during coverage run
issues.resolution: Fixed by remediator r1: explicit_address_is_honored (crates/clio-lib/src/http_bind_tests.rs) now retries probe+rebind up to 100 times on AddrInUse and only panics on non-AddrInUse errors; explicit_address_is_bound_exactly (crates/clio-lib/tests/mcp_http_bind_harness.rs) retries probe+spawn up to 10 times when the announced address does not match. Verified: `make check` exit 0 and `make coverage` coverage-guard clean (280 files).
issues.note: Pre-existing environment sensitivity, not caused by the fix: a bare (non-Makefile) `cargo test -p clio` fails ops_cli::tests::reindex_dense_confirmed_without_embedder_exits_3 because ~/.config/clio/deployment.json on this host configures an embed provider. The Makefile test/coverage targets export a hermetic CLIO_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG (Makefile:90, coverage.md), so `make test`, `make check` and `make coverage` all pass; documented behavior, left as-is.
issues.why_it_matters: The unit test binds to port 0, reads the assigned port, drops the listener, and immediately re-binds. If the socket lingers in TIME_WAIT or a parallel test thread binds the port, resolve_listener fails with AddrInUse (code 48).
issues.impact: Flaky test runs in CI and coverage gates (`make coverage` failed on the first run with 'bind explicit: Os { code: 48, kind: AddrInUse }').
issues.proposed_fix: Add a bounded retry loop when selecting and verifying an explicit port in http_bind_tests.rs and mcp_http_bind_harness.rs, similar to occupied_with_free_next().

issues.title: CLI flag parser does not support `--bind=HOST:PORT` syntax and silently falls back to auto-bind
issues.resolution: Fixed by remediator r1: parse_flags now splits `--flag=value` via split_once('=') before positional-value handling (crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs), additive for all shared consumers (ops, status, retention, compose, mcp). New tests parse_flags_equals_syntax and parse_flags_equals_value_beats_following_flag in main_tests.rs. Verified live: `clio mcp http --bind=127.0.0.1:34305 --db sqlite::memory:` prints 'mcp http listening on 127.0.0.1:34305'.
issues.why_it_matters: When a user passes `--bind=127.0.0.1:34305`, `parse_flags` does not split on `=` and stores key `bind=127.0.0.1:34305`. `flags.get("bind")` returns None, causing clio to silently auto-bind to 34300 instead of 34305.
issues.impact: Users passing standard `--flag=value` syntax receive no warning/error and are bound to an unexpected port.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:108: `target/debug/clio mcp http --bind=127.0.0.1:34305 --db sqlite::memory:` outputs 'mcp http listening on 127.0.0.1:34300'
issues.proposed_fix: In parse_flags, check if flag contains `=` (e.g. `flag.split_once('=')`) or reject unrecognized flag tokens.
